Open monitor Active processing 0 Jobs currently running or translating. Queued translations 0 Jobs waiting for worker or provider capacity. Failed today 0 Runs that ended with a failure today. Tokens today 0 Provider token usage from runs started today. Tokens last hour 0 Recent token usage for spotting spend spikes. Server health online Local CPU, memory, disk, and uptime snapshot. CPU n/a Current server CPU load when metrics are available. Memory n/a Current server memory use when metrics are available. Disk 25.9% Current server disk use when metrics are available. Uptime n/a How long the local process host has been up. What needs attention Queue growing while active processing stays flat means work is waiting. Degraded channels, 429s, timeouts, or no provider slots point to provider capacity. Failures today above zero need a recent run check before inviting more beta users. High disk, memory, or CPU can explain slow workers even when the queue is small. DeepSeek runtime Runtime cards show existing provider status only: active request slots, key channels, adaptive limit, circuit state, and reload state.
